chapter: Blackbirds, Carmen Jones and the Ziegfeld Follies
title: First BBC television broadcast and records with Eddie Condon
summary: He recalls making a BBC television broadcast and two Columbia records with Eddie Condon during two weeks in England.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: We had a good stay, westayed at the Palladium two weeks and come back. I had a beautiful time over there. The funniest thing about it, while we were over there we made the first broadcast of television for BBC. That's in 1930. We're now in 1930. And BBC made the first broadcast on television, BBC. Right. And then we made a couple of records with Eddie Condon over Columbia Records -- and what else did we do?
You made the records in England or --
Yeah, Columbia Records Company in England.
This was during the two weeks that you were there?
